title: Claim the tedious author and the tedious-gm-mcp package on the Foundry package listing
summary: ## Symptom The module now ships as `tedious-gm-mcp` by author `tedious`, but neither the package nor the author is registered on foundryvtt.com. ## Impact The release workflow's catalog submission (`release-modul.yml`, the `PACKAGE_TOKEN` step) has no package to submit to, so nobody can install the module from Foundry's built-in browser. Someone else could also claim the name first. ## Evidence - `packages/foundry-module/module.json`: `"id": "tedious-gm-mcp"`, author `tedious`. - `PACKAGE_TOKEN` is not set on this repository (AGENT.md, Infrastructure). ## Done when - The owner's foundryvtt.com account owns the `tedious-gm-mcp` package listing under author `tedious`. - Its package token is in the vault and seeded as `PACKAGE_TOKEN`, per the infra repo's credential rules.
